items.title: Cisco Q1 Earnings – Here’s What Analysts Expect from CSCO Stock amid AI Trade Concerns
items.summary: Networking giant Cisco Systems (CSCO) will announce its fiscal first-quarter earnings on November 12. While CSCO stock has declined 20% over the past month amid AI trade concerns and broader market pressures, it is still up 22% year-to-date. Cisco bulls remain optimistic due to AI-led demand for its products, with the company guiding for AI infrastructure revenue of $7.5 billion in FY27, up from $4 billion in the previous year.
